description.value: Hope Korean Kitchen is a Korean restaurant in Hope, BC, serving rice bowls, sizzling plates, soups, and appetizers including staples like beef bulgogi, bibimbap, and yangnyum chicken. Situated on Old Hope-Princeton Way, it is a convenient stop for cyclists passing through Hope on the Trans-Canada corridor. With 41 customer reviews and an online pickup ordering option, it is a well-established local dining spot with a reputation for fast service.
